method: Read all 131 recorded disagreements with source/context evidence, rather than voting. Concrete objectives remain separate even under the same event; relatedness requires a supported common initiative, material, transaction or physical work setup, not merely a person/domain. Links are explicit contextual annotations, not transitive merge instructions or causal claims. Pair-first uncertainty that concerns only the related/unrelated subtype can use full-library context when different objectives are clear; ambiguous same-versus-not-same pairs receive explicit uncertainty overrides. Full-context membership can identify a fragment without making every pair containing it identifiable. Recheck all sampled pairs whose contextual label changes. Record an additional root-discovered consensus correction separately. No model scores or previous final-test data were used. This is same-model-family agent review, not human review or exhaustive independent pair adjudication; relatedness and objective granularity remain product-policy assumptions.
